needed.evidence: Vehicles are parked directly against the building line with no visible sidewalk or path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a 1.5 m wide concrete footway between the building line and the parking bays.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road is lined with parked cars and residential buildings with no dedicated pedestrian path.
needed.suggestion: Install a 1.5 m wide footway on the right side to provide a safe walking surface away from the parked cars.

needed.evidence: The street has residential and commercial frontages on both sides, creating a high demand for crossing, but there is no marked or physical crossing facility.
needed.suggestion: Install a raised pedestrian crossing with a central refuge island to manage the high crossing demand.

needed.evidence: No street lamps are visible along the length of the road in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install a series of LED street lamps along both sides of the road to improve visibility and safety.
